title: ∂S = 0 and v ∧ S⃗ = 0 annihilate v-directional derivatives: S(Dβ[v]) = 0
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ with n ≥ 1, S ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), R = (M, θ, ξ) ∈ IMRep(ℝ^P, n) with S = τ(M, θ, ξ) (R.Represents S), and v ∈ ℝ^P. Assume ∂S = 0 (BoundaryVanishes S) and that for R.measure-a.e. x, ξ(x)(α.curryLeft v) = 0 for every (n+1)-covector α. Then S(γ) = 0 for all test forms β, γ ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P) such that γ(y) = Dβ(y)[v] (fderiv ℝ β y v) for every y ∈ ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (v : Euclid P), 0 < n → R.Represents S → BoundaryVanishes S → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, ∀ β : Covector (Euclid P) (n + 1), R.orient x (ContinuousAlternatingMap.curryLeft β v) = 0) → ∀ β γ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, (∀ y, (γ : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y = fderiv ℝ (β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) y v) → S γ = 0
